title: Set 84

sentences.ko: 잠드는 게 문제가 아니야. 매일 밤 세 시에 눈이 말똥말똥해지고 곧바로 회사 생각이 나. 그러고는 알람까지 몇 시간 남았나 세고 있는데, 그러면 당연히 더 못 자지. 그래서 아침에 이미 피곤한 채로 일어나. 이런 지 이 주쯤 됐어.
sentences.text: Falling asleep isn't the problem, it's that I'm wide awake at three every night and my head goes straight to work. And then I start counting how many hours I've got left before the alarm, which obviously just makes it worse. So I'm getting up already tired, and it's been like that for about two weeks now.

alts.text: Getting to sleep is fine, it's that I'm wide awake at three every night with my brain already on work. Then I'm lying there counting how many hours I've got till the alarm, which obviously makes it way worse. So I'm up already tired, and it's been like this for about two weeks.

The difficulty is not falling asleep; it is that I am completely awake at three every night and my mind turns immediately to work. I then begin counting how many hours remain before the alarm, which naturally only makes it worse. As a result, I am waking up already tired, and it has been that way for about two weeks now.

sentences.note: **wide awake** 는 잠이 확 달아나 눈이 말똥말똥한 상태를 말합니다. **my head goes straight to work** 는 눈 뜨자마자 생각이 곧장 일로 간다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 나는 6월 첫째 주 괜찮고, 아니면 7월 20일 지나서는 거의 아무 때나 돼. 방학 전이 다 싸니까 나는 6월이 더 좋고. 그런데 너희 언니 결혼식이 6월이라고 하지 않았어? 어느 주말인지만 알려 주면 그날 피해서 잡을게.
sentences.text: I can do the first week of June, or pretty much any time after July twentieth, and I'd rather do June because everything's cheaper before school gets out. But didn't you say your sister's wedding was in June? Just tell me which weekend it is and I'll plan around it.

alts.text: First week of June works for me, or basically any time after July twentieth, and I'd rather do June since everything's cheaper before school lets out. Wait, didn't you say your sister's wedding was in June? Just tell me which weekend it is and I'll work around it.

I am available the first week of June, or nearly any time after July twentieth, and I would prefer June because everything is less expensive before school ends. However, I believe you mentioned that your sister's wedding was in June. Please let me know which weekend it falls on and I will plan around it.

sentences.note: **plan around it** 은 그 일정을 피해서 나머지를 맞춘다는 뜻입니다. **school gets out** 은 학교가 끝나고 방학이 시작된다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 너희 애는 벌써 숙제 받아 와? 우리 애는 매일 밤 숙제 뭉치를 들고 오는데 아홉 시까지도 식탁에 앉아 있어. 일곱 살인데 말이야. 개학하고 둘째 주에 선생님한테 메일 보내는 학부모는 되기 싫은데, 슬슬 그렇게 될 것 같아.
sentences.text: Is yours getting homework yet? Because mine's coming home with a packet every night and she's still sitting at the table at nine o'clock, and she's seven. I don't want to be the parent who's emailing the teacher in the second week of school, but I'm getting close.

alts.text: Has yours started getting homework? Mine's bringing home a packet every single night and she's still at the table at nine o'clock, and she's seven. I really don't wanna be that parent emailing the teacher in the second week of school, but I'm getting pretty close.

Has your child begun receiving homework yet? Mine comes home with a packet every night and is still sitting at the table at nine o'clock, and she is seven. I would rather not be the parent who emails the teacher during the second week of school, but I am getting close.

sentences.note: **a packet** 은 학교에서 한 묶음으로 내주는 숙제를 말합니다. **I'm getting close** 는 아직 하진 않았지만 거의 그러기 직전까지 왔다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 마당에 다 차려 놨는데 사람들 오기 한 시간쯤 전에 비가 쏟아지기 시작했어. 그래서 결국 애들 열두 명이 거실에 있었지. 비가 그친 뒤에도 죄다 젖어 있어서 밖으로 내보낼 수가 없었고. 그러다 하필 네 시쯤에 딱 개더라, 사람들 이미 가는 중에.
sentences.text: We had the whole thing set up in the backyard and then it started pouring about an hour before anybody got there, so we ended up with twelve kids in the living room. And even after the rain stopped I couldn't send them back out, because everything was soaked. Then of course it cleared up right around four, when people were already leaving.

alts.text: Everything was already set up out back and then it just started pouring like an hour before anyone showed up, so we wound up with twelve kids in the living room. And even once the rain stopped I couldn't send them back out, cause everything was soaked. Then of course it cleared up right around four, when people were already heading out.

We had everything arranged in the backyard, and then it began pouring approximately an hour before anyone arrived, so we ended up with twelve children in the living room. Even after the rain stopped, I could not send them back outside because everything was soaked. Then, of course, it cleared up right around four o'clock, when people were already leaving.

sentences.note: **started pouring** 은 비가 퍼붓기 시작했다는 말이고, **cleared up** 은 비가 그치고 날이 갠다는 뜻입니다. **ended up with** 는 결국 그렇게 됐다는 결과를 말합니다.

sentences.ko: 예전 직장에서 같이 일하던 사람인데 말이 참 잘 통해. 근데 미리 말해 두는데, 전 남자친구 얘기가 자주 나와. 아직 못 잊어서 그런 건 아니고, 팔 년을 만났으니까 무슨 얘기를 해도 그 사람이 나오는 거야. 그게 신경 쓰일 것 같으면 지금 말해 줘. 그럼 걔한테 그 얘기 안 꺼낼게.
sentences.text: She's someone I worked with at my old job and she's really easy to talk to, but I'll tell you now, her ex comes up a lot. It's not that she's still hung up on him, it's just that they were together eight years, so he's in every story she tells. If that's going to bother you, say so now and I won't bring it up with her.

alts.text: I used to work with her at my old job and she's super easy to talk to, but heads up, her ex comes up a lot. It's not like she's still hung up on him, they were just together eight years, so he's in every story she tells. If that's gonna bug you, say so now and I won't bring it up with her.

She is a former colleague from my previous job and she is very easy to talk to, but I should mention that her ex comes up frequently. It is not that she is still attached to him; they were together for eight years, so he appears in every story she tells. If that would bother you, please say so now and I will not raise it with her.

sentences.note: **hung up on him** 은 헤어진 상대를 아직 못 잊고 마음에 두고 있다는 뜻입니다. **comes up** 은 이야기가 자연스럽게 화제로 나온다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구 소개팅 주선하면서 상대가 어떤 사람인지 설명하기

reviewed: 1번 casual: "it's the being wide awake at three" 는 원어민이 하지 않는 말이라 "it's that I'm wide awake at three every night with my brain already on work" 로 고쳤습니다. text 와는 시작이 다르게 두었습니다.
2번 formal: "did you not say that" 은 옛 문어체라 소리내어 읽으면 어색합니다. 뜻(6월인지 확인)은 그대로 두고 "I believe you mentioned that ..." 로 바꿨습니다.
5번 한국어 끝의 "그 사람한테 얘기 안 꺼낼게" 는 전 남자친구한테 말한다는 뜻으로 읽힙니다. 영어의 with her 에 맞게 "걔한테" 로 고쳐 소개할 친구를 가리키게 했습니다.
